sloka: द्विजान् वित्रासयन् धीमानुरसा पादपान् हरन् ।मृगांश्च सुबाहुन्निघ्नन् प्रवृद्ध इव केसरी॥५-१-४॥
transliteration: dvijān vitrāsayan dhīmānurasā pādapān haran ।mṛgāṁśca subāhunnighnan pravṛddha iva kesarī॥5-1-4॥

translations.english: Wise Hanuman went about like a lion scaring away birds, uprooting trees with his chest, and trampling many animals.
